notes.content:
Features
> Evaluated the formula for each guardian's attributes, accounting for diminishing returns on certain caps.

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch - New Enemy Biome introduced
notes.content:
[b]New features[/b]
> Introduced a new Biome of enemies the [b]Tree Folks[/b] !
> Meet them randomly and already from the very 1st dream!
> Expiration status effect such as Doom and Death have a [u]new behavior[/u]: Recasting on a target already affected reduces the duration by 1 (causing the effect based on expiration to happen earlier).

[b]QoL[/b]
> Moved the items destruction to the market place: Drag any item to the blue hand to destroy it for resources, OR, sell the item online.
> Improved the dream's events user interface with +/- buttons to change the number of waves.

[b]Fixes[/b]
> Fixed one variant version of the remnant strike circuit (wrong orientation).
> Various translations fixes.

-> Most of all added locales are not yet translated in other languages than english.

notes.title: [Update] New Features
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*]New Cube system available: It is now possible to slot circuits inside the cube and change its very core. This enables shadow's versions of Thyria to attack the ghosts... or upgrade the cube attacks.
[*]New User interface to cover this new system, including tutorial.
[*]New recipes have been created to cover the new "Circuit" item class.
[*]Existing trinket's descriptions have been refreshed so that it gives a strong insight of what it can produce.
[*]Trinkets are now stackable items. (displayed with a quantity)
[*]New offline market items proposed for a range of items (trinkets, charms, equipments). Refreshed every time the player reach the lobby. Online items are still proposed (would the player be online).
[/list]

notes.title: [Update] New Features & QoL
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
> The magical [b]inks [/b]resource becomes centric in various parts of the game. Additional to the Journal of the Damned, it allows to rewrite various parts of the dreams, including the events and the patient's fate.
> It is now possible to face successive Waves of monsters or ghosts while exploring the dreams. (Half of the corpses are destroyed (rounded down) in between successives waves)
> Dark Pustules can now be overcharged when firing at them. It allows to accomodate the risk/reward.
> Ghosts no longer have an invincibility frame. Hence the cube firing and Thyria's arsenal overlaps the damage. (Pre-Phase of the next big patch "automation" with Mandragores).
> Added new recipes.
> New animations for gathering items.
> New animation when inspecting a point of interest.
> Added a 'stackable' item class, which is a premise for the embeddable items in the next patch (It will be possible to bring items in the dream). Compatible with the market place.
> Starting items are no longer sellable at the market.
> New "easy" difficulty mode.

[b]QoL[/b]
> During battle the life bar mentions the pre-damage of DoTs in orange.
> Improved events effects when being completed.
> Improved mouse over outline tracking.

[b]Fixes[/b]
> Fixed whenever status effects were not cleaned-up fully in between battles.

notes.title: [Update] QoL and fixes
notes.content:
[b]Feature/QoL[/b]
> New Feedback system to display what are the latest changes unlocked by the player. Including, new powers, spells, crafting compounds available, new equipments, charms, available attribute points... The feedback have 2 natures: an eye to highlight a change, or an exclamation to indicate a possible action.

[b]Balancing[/b]
> All recipes difficulty have been lowered.
> The first items given in the scenario (stones and equipments) cannot be sold on the Market.

[b]Fixes[/b]
> All inputs text will validate only on enter or leaving field.
> The Market was not properly allowing the items to be bought only once.

[b]Graphical[/b]
> All Buttons have a mouse-over border highlighting and a revamped look.

notes.title: [Patch] QoL and Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Quality of Life/Improvements[/b]
- Most of tooltips have been changed from Delayed to Instant. This simplifies the inspection of various places in the game, but especially during the Laboratory guide. The game menu features a 'delayed tooltip' to change the default behavior of all tooltips (default:0 second).
- New fonts Material to display more precisely all non-latin languages. (Chinese, Russian, Koreana, Vietnamese, Japanese...)

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue with the Boneless when gathering the axe in between battles was granting more and more cold damage.
- Fixed a reoccuring dialog of Thyria when being back from a dream was displayed even when completing successfully the dream (Guardian's Curse dialog).
